items.briefing:
Cyber attacks in Australia rose 16% in July, with ransomware driving much of the increase. This means organisations like ours face a higher chance of being targeted right now, making it a good time to stay alert to suspicious emails, unexpected login requests, or unusual system behaviour. Separately, a survey found security leaders are more concerned than their own staff about the risks of AI tools — a reminder that using AI in your work may carry risks your team hasn't fully considered yet.

**Practical tip:** If you use any AI tools at work, check with your manager before entering sensitive or confidential information into them.

featured.title: Cyber attacks rise 16% as ransomware surges in July
featured.quote: Ransomware surge directly threatens Australian businesses with escalating financial and operational risks.
